import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Prepare features and target
X_train_full = train_df["text"].values
y_train_full = train_df["author"].values
X_test = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split into train and validation sets (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# TF-IDF Vectorizer with character n-grams
# Using character n-grams is effective for authorship attribution
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=50000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Model: LinearSVC with probability calibration
# LinearSVC is fast and effective for high-dimensional text data
base_clf = LinearSVC(random_state=42, verbose=0, max_iter=2000)
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="sigmoid", cv=3)

# Train the model
clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Predict probabilities on validation set
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)

# Calculate Log Loss on validation set
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss}")

# Predict probabilities on test set
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission dataframe
# Columns: id, EAP, HPL, MWS
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
